title: Investigate a service with Application Observability

blocks.content: Open the service catalog to investigate existing telemetry without configuring ingestion.

blocks.tooltip: Open the catalog to begin your investigation.

blocks.content: The service catalog is the starting point for an investigation scoped to one service.

blocks.title: Before you begin
blocks.content: Use an instance with Application Observability enabled and existing instrumented services; this guide does not set up telemetry.
Filter to instrumented services, inspect RED metrics, and compare traces, instrumentation quality, and entity metadata for the same service.
Choose **Performance**, filter to **Instrumented**, then open the first service; inferred services are outside this investigation.

steps.tooltip: Filter the catalog to services with instrumentation.
Open the first service in the filtered catalog.

blocks.content: Inspect **Service overview**: request rate shows traffic, error ratio shows the proportion of failed requests, and latency shows response time; compare all three over the same time range.
blocks.tooltip: Compare traffic, failures, and response time over the same time range.

blocks.content: Select **Traces** and check that the selected service remains in context; inspect the results or explicitly note the empty state for the current time range.
blocks.tooltip: Inspect available trace evidence for the selected service.

blocks.title: Read missing data carefully
blocks.content: An empty trace view does not establish that a service is healthy or unhealthy; describe what the view actually shows.

Select **Quality report** for the same service and inspect the instrumentation checks, or explicitly note that the report is still being generated; these checks describe telemetry quality, not whether the service is healthy.
blocks.tooltip: Distinguish telemetry quality from service health.

blocks.content: Select **Properties** and inspect the available entity metadata to confirm which service your investigation describes.
blocks.tooltip: Confirm the entity metadata for your investigation.

blocks.content: You followed one service from RED metrics to trace evidence, instrumentation quality or its report-generation state, and entity metadata while preserving its context.
